    🐲 Xi'xia Tribe¶

    A tribe of wargs inhabiting the center of Mia island, north of the Lumina Continent. They are not a nation and not an organized political entity — they are a tribe, like the goblins' clans. And they are the only wargs in the world born smarter than their kind.

    The Only Smart Wargs¶

    Everywhere else on Ge'or, wargs are animals — brilliant hunters, but untamable and unreasoning. The Xi'xia are different: they have evolved over millennia into something more. The reason is a perfect storm of the island and its history.

    • Isolation: separated from the mainland, the Mia wargs could not dilute with the wide, wild stock of wargs elsewhere.
    • The Old Lumina Empire: in the age of the beastmen's empire, the Old Lumina Empire conquered the island — and left its peoples upon it: the wargs, the trolls, and the other beastmen of Mia. When the empire fell, the island became a closed world.
    • The Hunt: trapped with trolls and beastmen as rivals, the wargs were hunted for generations. To survive they were forced to evolve their own systems — and by observing the two species they shared the island with, they learned to be smarter.

    Wargs are a highly mutable species; give a thousand small generations of pressure, and they change.

    Communication¶

    Xi'xia wargs are sought after across the whole world for one gift: they understand words — and they can communicate back, not by voice, but by gesture. A Xi'xia warg can hold a conversation in signals, respond to command and question, and make itself understood. They cannot speak, but they do not need to.

    No Religion, No Lords¶

    The tribe has no religion — no gods, no rites, no spirits — and no ruling structure beyond the pack. They are an ungoverned people of an ungoverned island, and they answer to no one.

    The Name¶

    They are called Xi'xia for the sound they make when referring to themselves.
